body:
Code Review by Qodo

🐞 Bugs (0) 📘 Rule violations (0) 📜 Skill insights (0)
1. The gate passes checks from the wrong app ✓ Resolved

Resolving commit: 9b5b1a8

>
>Resolution reason >
> >
>Required checks now carry their app id (app_id / integration_id, with -1 or absent meaning any app);
>check_checks only counts a check run whose app id matches the requirement, so a same-named result
>from a different app no longer satisfies an app-specific requirement. A regression test
>(t_required_check_from_its_app) asserts a wrong-app run is reported as missing.
>
>
>
>Description >
> >
>required_contexts() discards the app_id attached to required checks, and check_checks()
>matches results by context name alone. When a different app reports a successful check with that
>name on HEAD, the gate can pass even though the configured app has not reported its required check.
>
>

2. Qodo findings can have two dispositions ✓ Resolved

Resolving commit: 9b5b1a8

>
>Resolution reason >
> >
>Adds a duplicate check in check_dispositions() before seen.add(key): if key is already in seen, a
>disposition reason "two rows for: <finding>" is appended, so the gate fails on a repeated Qodo
>finding. Adds regression test t_one_row_per_finding that uses two rows for the same Qodo finding and
>asserts the gate fails with that message. This closely follows the suggested fix (reject a title
>already in seen, add a test with two rows).
>
>
>
>Description >
> >
>check_dispositions() adds each Qodo title to seen without rejecting a title already in the set.
>When a dispositions table repeats a finding, both rows can pass validation and the gate reports
>every finding decided despite the conflicting record.
>
>
3. An edited hold releases paths nobody approved ✓ Resolved

Resolving commit: 9b5b1a8

>
>Resolution reason >
> >
>Trusted room messages now carry an "edited" timestamp (updated_at). check_sensitive and
>RoomLog.answers only accept an ask/hold that stood unedited before the DECISION was posted; an edit
>after the decision is rejected with a message to post a new hold/escalation. A regression test with
>an edited hold and escalation was added.
>
>
>
>Description >
> >
>check_sensitive reads the lead's MERGE-HOLD-<n> text as it stands when the gate runs. It then
>accepts any trusted DECISION-<n> whose comment id is larger than the hold's, but editing a GitHub
>comment keeps its id and parse() never reads updated_at. So if the lead edits an answered hold
>to add a newly matched path, which is what the gate's own "doesn't name X (the form: …)" message
>invites, the old decision passes for a path Matthew never saw. RoomLog.answers has the same gap
>for top-severity owner decisions: an ESCALATION-<n> edited after the decision to name another
>finding makes that decision cover it.
>
>

4. An unused room lookup is left behind ✓ Resolved

Resolving commit: 9b5b1a8

>
>Resolution reason >
> >
>Removed the unused RoomLog.decision() method so no caller can get a DECISION without the ordering
>and edit checks; decisions() and before() remain.
>
>
>
>Description >
> >
>RoomLog.decision(kind) returns the first trusted decision of a kind, but nothing in room.py calls
>it: check_sensitive and answers both use decisions() with their own ordering rules. A later
>caller could reach for decision() and get a DECISION without the hold and escalation ordering that
>R2-1 and R2-2 added.
>
>

### The AI Code Review Platform

## Get Started
Simply sign into Github and click the "Configure" button. Check out our documentation for more info: https://docs.qodo.ai/get-started.

## Overview
Qodo automatically reviews every GitHub pull request, identifies logic bugs, edge cases, security issues, and code quality problems, and provides actionable suggestions your team can apply immediately.

Install in minutes. Integrates seamlessly into your existing workflows.

## Qodo is designed for developers who:
- Handle frequent pull requests and need reliable review coverage
- Balance code quality with fast delivery
- Work in complex, multi-repo systems
- Use AI-generated code and need stronger guardrails
- Build production software where reliability matters

## Qodo Capabilities
- ## Automated PR Analysis
  - Reviews every pull request automatically
  - No manual trigger required

- ## Context-Aware Code Review
  - Understands cross-file changes
  - Detects architectural inconsistencies

- ## Actionable Suggestions
  - Concrete code fixes
  - Clear explanations
  - Prioritized feedback

- ## Security & Reliability Checks
  - Identifies risky patterns
  - Reduces attack surface area
